cc:Work.dc:description:
import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Supplied dimensionless signal and the stated Fourier-transform convention. x = np.array([4, 2, 0, 2], dtype=float) N = 4 n = np.arange(N) k = np.arange(N) U = np.exp(2j * np.pi * np.outer(n, k) / N) X = U.conj().T @ x c = X / N if not np.allclose(X, [8, 4, 0, 4]) or not np.allclose(U @ c, x): raise ValueError("The supplied signal and transform coefficients are inconsistent.")
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" INK = "#263238" SLATE = "#657786"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 11, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.color": INK, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 1) ax.set_ylim(0, 1) ax.axis("off")
def text(xpos, ypos, label, size=11, color=INK, **kwargs): return ax.text( xpos, ypos, label, fontsize=size, color=color, ha=kwargs.pop("ha", "left"), va=kwargs.pop("va", "center"), **kwargs )
text(0.035, 0.940, "DFT / IDFT pair", size=17, weight="semibold") text( 0.965, 0.940, r"$N=4 \qquad \mathbf{x}=[4,\,2,\,0,\,2]^{\mathsf{T}}$", size=13, ha="right" )
# A single understated divider separates the two conceptual operations. ax.plot([0.505, 0.505], [0.165, 0.835], color="#E5EAE8", lw=0.9)
text(0.035, 0.810, "Forward Transform (DFT)", size=13, weight="semibold") text(0.035, 0.750, "Inner product extraction", size=11, color=SLATE) text(0.540, 0.810, "Inverse Transform (IDFT)", size=13, weight="semibold") text(0.540, 0.750, "Basis synthesis", size=11, color=SLATE)
text( 0.035, 0.650, r"$X_k=\langle u_k,\mathbf{x}\rangle" r"=\sum_{n=0}^{3}x_n\,e^{-i\,2\pi kn/4}$", size=12 )
calculations = [ r"$X_0=4+2+0+2=8$", r"$X_1=4+2(-i)+0(-1)+2(i)=4$", r"$X_2=4+2(-1)+0(1)+2(-1)=0$", r"$X_3=4+2(i)+0(-1)+2(-i)=4$", ] for ypos, label in zip([0.535, 0.445, 0.355, 0.265], calculations): text(0.052, ypos, label, size=11.5, color=BLUE)
text( 0.052, 0.151, r"$\mathbf{X}=[8,\,4,\,0,\,4]^{\mathsf{T}}$", size=13, color=BLUE ) text(0.052, 0.090, "Unnormalized inner products", size=9.2, color=SLATE)
text( 0.540, 0.650, r"$x_n=\frac{1}{4}\sum_{k=0}^{3}X_k\,e^{+i\,2\pi kn/4}" r"=\sum_{k=0}^{3}c_k u_{k,n}$", size=11.1 ) text( 0.540, 0.548, r"$c_k=X_k/4,\qquad \mathbf{c}=[2,\,1,\,0,\,1]^{\mathsf{T}}$", size=11.5, color=TEAL ) text( 0.540, 0.456, r"$\mathbf{x}=2u_0+1u_1+0u_2+1u_3$", size=11.5 )
def column_vector(cx, cy, entries, color, width=0.051, height=0.178): """Draw a four-entry column vector with lightweight square brackets.""" ys = np.linspace(cy + height * 0.375, cy - height * 0.375, 4) for yy, entry in zip(ys, entries): text(cx, yy, f"${entry}$", size=11, color=color, ha="center") left, right = cx - width / 2, cx + width / 2 top, bottom = cy + height / 2, cy - height / 2 cap = 0.006 ax.plot( [left + cap, left, left, left + cap], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=color, lw=0.85 ) ax.plot( [right - cap, right, right, right - cap], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=color, lw=0.85 )
cy = 0.303 text(0.542, cy, "$=$", size=13) column_vector(0.595, cy, ["2", "2", "2", "2"], TEAL) text(0.641, cy, "$+$", size=13, ha="center") column_vector(0.688, cy, ["1", "i", "-1", "-i"], TEAL) text(0.734, cy, "$+$", size=13, ha="center") column_vector(0.781, cy, ["1", "-i", "-1", "i"], TEAL) text(0.830, cy, "$=$", size=13, ha="center") column_vector(0.884, cy, ["4", "2", "0", "2"], INK)
text( 0.540, 0.128, r"The imaginary parts in $c_1u_1$ and $c_3u_3$ cancel:", size=9.5, color=SLATE ) text( 0.540, 0.073, r"$+i$ and $-i$ sum to zero, leaving the real vector $\mathbf{x}$.", size=9.5, color=SLATE )
